user.title: Choose a calendar for Shift Planner
user.description: Choose the Local Calendar where Shift Planner will create events. You can manage shift names and times under Configure after setup.

error.not_local_calendar: Select an entity from the Local Calendar integration.
error.not_writable: The calendar does not support creating events.

abort.already_configured: This calendar already has a Shift Planner.

init.title: Manage shifts
init.description: Configured shifts for this calendar: **{shift_count}**. Choose what you want to do below.

menu_option_descriptions.add: Create a shift with its own name and hours.
menu_option_descriptions.edit: Change the name or hours of an existing shift.
menu_option_descriptions.remove: Remove a shift from the planner without deleting calendar events.

add.title: Add a shift
add.description: Give the shift a unique name and set its hours. If the end time is earlier than the start time, the shift ends the next day.

edit.title: Choose a shift to edit
edit.description: Select a shift to open its current settings.

edit_shift.title: Edit shift details
edit_shift.description: Update the name or hours for future shifts. Events already in the calendar will not change. If the end time is earlier than the start time, the shift ends the next day.

remove.title: Remove a shift
remove.description: Select the shift to remove from the planner. Events already in the calendar will not be deleted.

error.empty_name: Enter a name for the shift.
error.duplicate_name: A shift with this name already exists.
error.same_time: Start and end times must be different.
